# HoloCard

> Turn any photo into an interactive holographic card: it is split into foreground, midground and background layers, each with its own foil. Use it right in the browser; free, no sign-up, open source (GPL-3.0).

HoloCard is a web tool. Upload a photo and the server splits it into 2–4 layers with monocular depth estimation; each layer is both a parallax image and the mask for that layer's foil. The front end renders it as a holographic card in the style of a Pokémon holo: as the card turns, the foils and glare change with the angle and the layers move in parallax.

- Use it online: https://holocard.longsizhuo.com/
- Finished cards get a share link; anyone who opens it can tilt the card
- Accepts JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF and HEIC, up to 16 MB per image
- Finished cards can be saved as animations: GIF on iPhone, Motion Photo on Android, APNG on desktop
- Interface in English, Chinese and Japanese: https://holocard.longsizhuo.com/ , https://holocard.longsizhuo.com/?lang=zh , https://holocard.longsizhuo.com/?lang=ja
- Author: longsizhuo (https://github.com/longsizhuo)

## How it works

- Depth estimation: Depth Anything V2-Small (ONNX, 8-bit quantized) runs on the server, so the browser downloads no model
- Layering: layers are cut at the valleys of the depth histogram, and their number adapts to the photo; a cut is made only where the boundary is visible in the image and there is a real occlusion step in depth, so no object is split in two
- Edges: depth edges are first snapped into steps, then a guided filter snaps the layer boundaries to the real object edges in the photo
- Filling: regions hidden behind the foreground are filled by mirroring the real texture from the other side of the boundary, with the nearest visible pixel as the mirror; no generative model is used
- Rendering: the foil effects and interaction are ported from pokemon-cards-css (Simon Goellner, GPL-3.0); each layer uses its own alpha as its foil mask

## Links

- [Source code](https://github.com/longsizhuo/holocard): GitHub repository, GPL-3.0
- [Documentation](https://holocard.longsizhuo.com/docs/en/): usage, the HTTP API, the layering pipeline, edge refinement, the renderer and the .layers format
- [pokemon-cards-css](https://github.com/simeydotme/pokemon-cards-css): the origin of the foil effects

## 中文

HoloCard 是一个免费、开源（GPL-3.0）的网页工具，把任意照片自动切成前中后景，每层各上各的箔面，渲染成可交互的全息闪卡，无需注册。服务端用 Depth Anything V2-Small 估计深度，把照片分成 2～4 层；转动卡片时，箔面和炫光随角度变化，各层之间有视差。箔面效果移植自 Simon Goellner 的 pokemon-cards-css。做好的卡可以生成分享链接，也可以存成动图：iPhone 上是 GIF，安卓上是动态照片，电脑上是 APNG。中文版：https://holocard.longsizhuo.com/?lang=zh ，文档：https://holocard.longsizhuo.com/docs/ ，源码：https://github.com/longsizhuo/holocard

## 日本語

HoloCard は、どんな写真もインタラクティブなキラカードにする無料・オープンソース（GPL-3.0）の Web ツールです。Depth Anything V2-Small で深度を推定し、写真を前景・中景・背景の 2～4 レイヤーに分け、レイヤーごとにホイルを重ねます。カードを傾けると、ホイルとレイヤーが視差で動きます。できたカードは iPhone では GIF、Android ではモーションフォト、パソコンではアニメーション PNG として保存できます。ホイルの表現は Simon Goellner の pokemon-cards-css から移植しています。日本語版：https://holocard.longsizhuo.com/?lang=ja 、ソースコード：https://github.com/longsizhuo/holocard
